institution: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid (UC3M), GREMA - Madrid, Spain
details: PhD researcher since 12/2022. Supervisor: Daniel Segovia Vargas
SiGe BiCMOS on-chip antennas and mmWave front-ends above 100 GHz, extending beyond 200 GHz, for automotive, space and communication applications.
Validation with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, probe stations, frequency extenders, anecoic chambers, and planar near-field setups.
Conducted a fully funded research stay on millimeter-wave, THz, and optical systems for biomedical and space applications in an international research environment.
